publish_subject: Preparatory commit for 3.0.10 master release: - Updated code installation instructions for GitHub distribution - New code update scripts - Support of IMAS-ParaView with Intel toolchain at ITER - Upgrade to IMAS-ParaView/2.3.0 at ITER to fix a VTK issue - Revert to JSON-fortran v.8.5.2 at ITER to avoid a gfortran segmentation fault error - Pointer to B2.5 submodule with initial 3.0.10 commit, bug fixes to new netCDF quantities, IMAS DD/4.1.0 identifiers, conversion rule for b2.neoclassical_transport.parameters, IDS deallocation, ELM transport coefficient profiles - Pointer to Eirene submodule with LaTeX Manual clean-up - Bug fixes to netCDF plotting scripts - Correction to main Makefile for CMake version 4 (provided by Stefano Carli) - Corrections to PITAGORA X11 library location (reported by Elena Tonello) - Rebuilt examples with new last10 and netCDF analysis plots - Build separate nc2text executables with and without debug options
